correctness.rationale: Fix r cyclic roots and their cyclic permutation. Cayley forest count r n^(n-r-1) and deletion of j forbidden roots give avoidance probability (r-j)(n-j)^(n-r-1)/(r n^(n-r-1)); for j=r<n it is zero. This matches r-1 marked boxes after n-r-1 independent uniform throws with one compulsory occupied root. Inclusion-exclusion determines the full law, including r=n permutation boundary. The total marked-binomial-to-Poisson coupling gives TV<= (r-1)/n and p=e^(-(n-r-1)/n). Exact R_n tail (n)_r/n^r produces Rayleigh n^1/2 scale; conditional triangular binomial CLT gives centered n^1/4 normal mixture with variance e^-1(1-e^-1)X. Independently enumerated all n^n mappings n=2..5 by their cyclic vertices and indegrees and matched exact conditional mean for every r. Finiteness does not establish weak convergence; analytic conditional CLT/tightness do.
